# WATER

```{r Water}
#Clear workspace
rm(list=ls())

# BUILD PHYLOSEQ
otu <- read.table(file = "/exported-water/water-decontam-sans-a-m-c-t-k.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T, row.names = 1, comment.char = "")

taxonomy <- read.table(file = "/exported-water/taxonomy.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T ,row.names = 1)

# clean the taxonomy, Greengenes format
tax <- taxonomy %>%
  select(Taxon) %>% 
  separate(Taxon, c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"), "; ")

tax.clean <- data.frame(row.names = row.names(tax),
                        Kingdom = str_replace(tax[,1], "k__",""),
                        Phylum = str_replace(tax[,2], "p__",""),
                        Class = str_replace(tax[,3], "c__",""),
                        Order = str_replace(tax[,4], "o__",""),
                        Family = str_replace(tax[,5], "f__",""),
                        Genus = str_replace(tax[,6], "g__",""),
                        Species = str_replace(tax[,7], "s__",""),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

tax.clean[is.na(tax.clean)] <- ""
tax.clean[tax.clean=="__"] <- ""

# For all empty cells, replace with "Unclassified" so it is apparent when you grab specific levels that there was no specific classification
for (i in 1:nrow(tax.clean)){
  if (tax.clean[i,7] != ""){
    tax.clean$Species[i] <- paste(tax.clean$Genus[i], tax.clean$Species[i], sep = " ")
  } else if (tax.clean[i,2] == ""){
    kingdom <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,1], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 2:7] <- kingdom
  } else if (tax.clean[i,3] == ""){
    phylum <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,2], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 3:7] <- phylum
  } else if (tax.clean[i,4] == ""){
    class <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,3], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 4:7] <- class
  } else if (tax.clean[i,5] == ""){
    order <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,4], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 5:7] <- order
  } else if (tax.clean[i,6] == ""){
    family <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,5], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 6:7] <- family
  } else if (tax.clean[i,7] == ""){
    tax.clean$Species[i] <- paste("Unclassified ",tax.clean$Genus[i], sep = " ")
  }
}

# load metadata
metadata <- read.table(file = "/core-metrics-results-water/Tadpole_Metadata_Water_Barplots.txt", sep = "\t", header = FALSE, row.names=1, skip=1)
colnames(metadata)<-c("absolute-filepath","direction","Type","Type2","Tank_ID","Day","Pond_Treatment","Pond","PW_Percentage","Treatment","ASVs","Shannon","Faiths","Evenness")
OTU = otu_table(as.matrix(otu), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
TAX = tax_table(as.matrix(tax.clean))
SAMPLE <- sample_data(metadata)
TREE = read_tree("/exported-water/tree.nwk")

# merge the data
ps <- phyloseq(OTU, TAX, SAMPLE,TREE)

# Abundance bar plot by Phylum - Growth and culture conditions 
# change to character for easy-adjusted level
ps.rel = transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x/sum(x)*100)
# agglomerate taxa
glom <- tax_glom(ps.rel, taxrank = 'Phylum', NArm = FALSE)
Source.abundance <- subset_samples(glom, Type == "Source")
Con.abundance <- subset_samples(glom, Type == "Control")
ConD0.abundance <- subset_samples(Con.abundance, Day == "0")
ConD6.abundance <- subset_samples (Con.abundance, Day == "6")
Inhab.abundance <-subset_samples(glom, Type == "Water")

ps.melt.Source <- psmelt(Source.abundance)
ps.melt.ConD0 <- psmelt(ConD0.abundance)
ps.melt.ConD6 <- psmelt(ConD6.abundance)
ps.melt.Inhab <- psmelt(Inhab.abundance)

ps.melt.Source$Phylum <- as.character(ps.melt.Source$Phylum)
ps.melt.Source$Type2 <- factor(ps.melt.Source$Type2, levels = c("Dep",""))
ps.melt.Source$Pond <- factor(ps.melt.Source$Pond, levels = c("LW","PLE","PM"))
ps.melt.Source$Treatmemt <- factor(ps.melt.Source$Treatment, levels = c("A","F","U"))

ps.melt.ConD0$Phylum <- as.character(ps.melt.ConD0$Phylum)
ps.melt.ConD0$Type2 <- factor(ps.melt.ConD0$Type2, levels = c("Dep",""))
ps.melt.ConD0$Pond <- factor(ps.melt.ConD0$Pond, levels = c("LW","PLE","PM"))
ps.melt.ConD0$Pond_Treatment <- factor(ps.melt.ConD0$Pond_Treatment, levels = c("LW","A-PLE","F-PLE","A-PM","F-PM","PLE","PM"))
ps.melt.ConD0$PW_Percentage <- factor(ps.melt.ConD0$PW_Percentage, levels = c(0, 1, 25, 50, 75, 100))

ps.melt.ConD6$Phylum <- as.character(ps.melt.ConD6$Phylum)
ps.melt.ConD6$Type2 <- factor(ps.melt.ConD6$Type2, levels = c("Dep",""))
ps.melt.ConD6$Pond <- factor(ps.melt.ConD6$Pond, levels = c("LW","PLE","PM"))
ps.melt.ConD6$Pond_Treatment <- factor(ps.melt.ConD6$Pond_Treatment, levels = c("LW","A-PLE","F-PLE","A-PM","F-PM","PLE","PM"))
ps.melt.ConD6$PW_Percentage <- factor(ps.melt.ConD6$PW_Percentage, levels = c(0, 1, 25, 50, 75, 100))

ps.melt.Inhab$Phylum <- as.character(ps.melt.Inhab$Phylum)
ps.melt.Inhab$Type2 <- factor(ps.melt.Inhab$Type2, levels = c("Dep",""))
ps.melt.Inhab$Pond <- factor(ps.melt.Inhab$Pond, levels = c("LW","PLE","PM"))
ps.melt.Inhab$Pond_Treatment <- factor(ps.melt.Inhab$Pond_Treatment, levels = c("LW","A-PLE","F-PLE","A-PM","F-PM","PLE","PM"))
ps.melt.Inhab$PW_Percentage <- factor(ps.melt.Inhab$PW_Percentage, levels = c(0, 1, 25, 50, 75, 100))

#add median to the tables
ps.melt.Source <- ps.melt.Source %>%
  group_by(Type2, Pond, Treatment, Phylum) %>%
  mutate(median=median(Abundance))

ps.melt.ConD0 <- ps.melt.ConD0 %>%
  group_by(Type2, Pond, Pond_Treatment, PW_Percentage, Phylum) %>%
  mutate(median=median(Abundance))

ps.melt.ConD6 <- ps.melt.ConD6 %>%
  group_by(Type2, Pond, Pond_Treatment, PW_Percentage, Phylum) %>%
  mutate(median=median(Abundance))

ps.melt.Inhab <- ps.melt.Inhab %>%
  group_by(Type2, Pond, Pond_Treatment, PW_Percentage, Phylum) %>%
  mutate(median=median(Abundance))

# select group median > 1
keep <- unique(ps.melt.Source$Phylum[ps.melt.Source$median > 1])
ps.melt.Source$Phylum[!(ps.melt.Source$Phylum %in% keep)] <- "< 1% Abundance"

keep <- unique(ps.melt.ConD0$Phylum[ps.melt.ConD0$median > 1])
ps.melt.ConD0$Phylum[!(ps.melt.ConD0$Phylum %in% keep)] <- "< 1% Abundance"

keep <- unique(ps.melt.ConD6$Phylum[ps.melt.ConD6$median > 1])
ps.melt.ConD6$Phylum[!(ps.melt.ConD6$Phylum %in% keep)] <- "< 1% Abundance"

keep <- unique(ps.melt.Inhab$Phylum[ps.melt.Inhab$median > 1])
ps.melt.Inhab$Phylum[!(ps.melt.Inhab$Phylum %in% keep)] <- "< 1% Abundance"

#to get the same rows together
ps.melt.Source_sum <- ps.melt.Source %>%
  group_by(Sample, Type2, Pond, Treatment, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(Abundance=sum(Abundance))

ps.melt.ConD0_sum <- ps.melt.ConD0 %>%
  group_by(Sample, Type2, Pond, Pond_Treatment, PW_Percentage, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(Abundance=sum(Abundance))

ps.melt.ConD6_sum <- ps.melt.ConD6 %>%
  group_by(Sample, Type2, Pond, Pond_Treatment, PW_Percentage, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(Abundance=sum(Abundance))

ps.melt.Inhab_sum <- ps.melt.Inhab %>%
  group_by(Sample, Type2, Pond, Pond_Treatment, PW_Percentage, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(Abundance=sum(Abundance))

# Plot Source Water Samples
ps.melt.Source_sum$Type2 <- factor(ps.melt.Source_sum$Type2, levels = c("Dep",""))
ps.melt.Source_sum$Pond <- factor(ps.melt.Source_sum$Pond, levels = c("LW","PLE","PM"))
ps.melt.Source_sum$Treatment <- factor(ps.melt.Source_sum$Treatment, levels = c("A","F","U"))

cols = c("#4E79A7","#A0CBE8","#F28E2B","#FFBE7D","#59A14F","#8CD17D","#B6992D","#F1CE63","#499894","#86BCB6","#E15759","#FF9D9A","#79706E","#BAB0AC","#D37295","#FABFD2","#B07AA1","#D4A6C8")
c1<-ggplot(ps.melt.Source_sum , aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Phylum)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", aes(fill=Phylum)) + 
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cols,
    aesthetics = c("fill"),
    name="Phylum",
  )+
  labs(x="", y="% Relative Abundance") +
  facet_wrap(Type2~Pond+Treatment, scales= "free_x", nrow=1) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size=10),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text=element_text(size=12),
        axis.title=element_text(size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(size=8),
        legend.title=element_text(size=12),
        legend.key.height = unit(4.5, "mm"))

ggexport(c1, filename="Water_Source_Phylum_names.pdf", width = 8, height = 4)

c2<-ggplot(ps.melt.Source_sum , aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Phylum)) +

##By Family

ps.rel = transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x/sum(x)*100)
# agglomerate taxa
glom <- tax_glom(ps.rel, taxrank = 'Family', NArm = FALSE)
Source.abundance <- subset_samples(glom, Type == "Source")
Con.abundance <- subset_samples(glom, Type == "Control")
ConD0.abundance <- subset_samples(Con.abundance, Day == "0")
ConD6.abundance <- subset_samples (Con.abundance, Day == "6")
Inhab.abundance <-subset_samples(glom, Type == "Water")

ps.melt.Source <- psmelt(Source.abundance)
ps.melt.ConD0 <- psmelt(ConD0.abundance)
ps.melt.ConD6 <- psmelt(ConD6.abundance)
ps.melt.Inhab <- psmelt(Inhab.abundance)

ps.melt.Source$Family <- as.character(ps.melt.Source$Family)
ps.melt.Source$Type2 <- factor(ps.melt.Source$Type2, levels = c("Dep",""))
ps.melt.Source$Pond <- factor(ps.melt.Source$Pond, levels = c("LW","PLE","PM"))

#add median to the tables

  group_by(Type2, Pond, Treatment, Family) %>%
  mutate(median=median(Abundance))

ps.melt.ConD0 <- ps.melt.ConD0 %>%
  group_by(Type2, Pond, Pond_Treatment, PW_Percentage, Family) %>%
  mutate(median=median(Abundance))

ps.melt.ConD6 <- ps.melt.ConD6 %>%

  mutate(median=median(Abundance))

# select group median > 5
keep <- unique(ps.melt.Source$Family[ps.melt.Source$median > 5])
ps.melt.Source$Family[!(ps.melt.Source$Family %in% keep)] <- "< 5% Abundance"

keep <- unique(ps.melt.ConD0$Family[ps.melt.ConD0$median > 5])
```

# GUT

```{r Gut}
# Clear workspace
rm(list=ls())

# BUILD PHYLOSEQ
otu <- read.table(file = "/exported-gut/gut-decontam-sans-a-m-c-t-k.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T, row.names = 1, comment.char = "")

taxonomy <- read.table(file = "/exported-gut/taxonomy.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T ,row.names = 1)

# clean the taxonomy, Greengenes format
tax <- taxonomy %>%
  select(Taxon) %>% 
  separate(Taxon, c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"), "; ")

tax.clean <- data.frame(row.names = row.names(tax),
                        Kingdom = str_replace(tax[,1], "k__",""),
                        Phylum = str_replace(tax[,2], "p__",""),
                        Class = str_replace(tax[,3], "c__",""),
                        Order = str_replace(tax[,4], "o__",""),
                        Family = str_replace(tax[,5], "f__",""),
                        Genus = str_replace(tax[,6], "g__",""),
                        Species = str_replace(tax[,7], "s__",""),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

tax.clean[is.na(tax.clean)] <- ""
tax.clean[tax.clean=="__"] <- ""

for (i in 1:nrow(tax.clean)){
  if (tax.clean[i,7] != ""){
    tax.clean$Species[i] <- paste(tax.clean$Genus[i], tax.clean$Species[i], sep = " ")
  } else if (tax.clean[i,2] == ""){
    kingdom <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,1], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 2:7] <- kingdom
  } else if (tax.clean[i,3] == ""){
    phylum <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,2], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 3:7] <- phylum
  } else if (tax.clean[i,4] == ""){
    class <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,3], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 4:7] <- class
  } else if (tax.clean[i,5] == ""){
    order <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,4], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 5:7] <- order
  } else if (tax.clean[i,6] == ""){
    family <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,5], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 6:7] <- family
  } else if (tax.clean[i,7] == ""){
    tax.clean$Species[i] <- paste("Unclassified ",tax.clean$Genus[i], sep = " ")
  }
}

# load metadata
metadata <- read.table(file = "/core-metrics-results-gut/Tadpole_Metadata_Gut_Alpha.txt", sep = "\t", header = FALSE, row.names=1, skip=1)
colnames(metadata)<-c("name","Type","Type2","Tank_ID","Tadpole #","Day","Group","Pond_Treatment","Pond","PW_Percentage","Percentage","Treatment","Tannins (Y/N)","Tadpole Weight (g)","Tadpole Length (mm)","Gosner Stage","log(Mass)","log(length)","ASVs","Shannon","Faiths","Evenness")
OTU = otu_table(as.matrix(otu), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
TAX = tax_table(as.matrix(tax.clean))
SAMPLE <- sample_data(metadata)
TREE = read_tree("/exported-gut/tree.nwk")

# merge the data
ps <- phyloseq(OTU, TAX, SAMPLE,TREE)

# Abundance bar plot by Phylum - Growth and culture conditions 
# change to character for easy-adjusted level
ps.rel = transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x/sum(x)*100)
# agglomerate taxa
glom <- tax_glom(ps.rel, taxrank = 'Phylum', NArm = FALSE)

ps.melt <- psmelt(glom)

ps.melt$Phylum <- as.character(ps.melt$Phylum)
ps.melt$Type <- factor(ps.melt$Type, levels = c("Dep",""))
ps.melt$Pond <- factor(ps.melt$Pond, levels = c("LW","PLE","PM"))
ps.melt$Pond_Treatment <- factor(ps.melt$Pond_Treatment, levels = c("LW","A-PLE","F-PLE","A-PM","F-PM","PLE","PM"))
ps.melt$PW_Percentage <- factor(ps.melt$PW_Percentage, levels = c(0, 1, 25, 50, 100))

#add median to the tables
ps.melt <- ps.melt %>%
  group_by(Type, Pond, Pond_Treatment, PW_Percentage, Phylum) %>%
  mutate(median=median(Abundance))

# select group median > 1
keep <- unique(ps.melt$Phylum[ps.melt$median > 1])
ps.melt$Phylum[!(ps.melt$Phylum %in% keep)] <- "< 1% Abundance"

#to get the same rows together
ps.melt_sum <- ps.melt %>%
  group_by(Sample, Type, Pond, Pond_Treatment, PW_Percentage, Phylum) %>%

    aesthetics = c("fill"),

  )+
  labs(x="", y="% Relative Abundance") +
  facet_wrap(Type~Pond+Pond_Treatment+PW_Percentage, scales= "free_x", nrow=1) +
```

```{r Skin}
# Clear workspace
rm(list=ls())

# BUILD PHYLOSEQ
otu2 <- read.table(file = "/exported-skin/skin-decontam-sans-a-m-c-t-k.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T, row.names = 1, comment.char = "")

taxonomy2 <- read.table(file = "/exported-skin/taxonomy.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T ,row.names = 1)

# clean the taxonomy, Greengenes format
tax <- taxonomy2 %>%
  select(Taxon) %>% 
  separate(Taxon, c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"), "; ")

tax.clean <- data.frame(row.names = row.names(tax),
                        Kingdom = str_replace(tax[,1], "k__",""),
                        Phylum = str_replace(tax[,2], "p__",""),
                        Class = str_replace(tax[,3], "c__",""),
                        Order = str_replace(tax[,4], "o__",""),
                        Family = str_replace(tax[,5], "f__",""),
                        Genus = str_replace(tax[,6], "g__",""),
                        Species = str_replace(tax[,7], "s__",""),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

tax.clean[is.na(tax.clean)] <- ""
tax.clean[tax.clean=="__"] <- ""

for (i in 1:nrow(tax.clean)){
  if (tax.clean[i,7] != ""){
    tax.clean$Species[i] <- paste(tax.clean$Genus[i], tax.clean$Species[i], sep = " ")
  } else if (tax.clean[i,2] == ""){
    kingdom <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,1], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 2:7] <- kingdom
  } else if (tax.clean[i,3] == ""){
    phylum <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,2], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 3:7] <- phylum
  } else if (tax.clean[i,4] == ""){
    class <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,3], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 4:7] <- class
  } else if (tax.clean[i,5] == ""){
    order <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,4], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 5:7] <- order
  } else if (tax.clean[i,6] == ""){
    family <- paste("Unclassified", tax.clean[i,5], sep = " ")
    tax.clean[i, 6:7] <- family
  } else if (tax.clean[i,7] == ""){
    tax.clean$Species[i] <- paste("Unclassified ",tax.clean$Genus[i], sep = " ")
  }
}

# load metadata
```
